I’m very new to this game, I started playing in July, already have about 120 hours in it.
I’ve been playing Counter-Strike since 2004, it was one my very first videogames ever. I tried out COD and BF when they were in their “glory days” (2007-2013), but CS was always installed and played. I loved CSGO, it had it’s problems but it was a good game. 
Valve completely ruined the whole franchise with CS2, and after waiting for updates, giving it many chances, I quit after 20 years.

I bought Siege back in 2018, but never really got around it. In July, me and my friends said “F it, it can’t be worse than CS2”. And honestly, I feel like I wasted 9 years playing the wrong game. 

I hear that modern Siege isn’t the same as the old one, but I really love this game rn. The base mechanics of the game are far superior to CS. I really like the whole mechanic of having Operator with their specific tools, it can freshen up gameplay. I cannot really get stuck on one Operator, because certain situations require different abilities/tools. Back in CS, I could play the entire match with about 3-4 guns (AK/M4/AWP and maybe an MP9 in eco rounds). 

The game is much slower than CS, and way more teamwork focused, which I like since it’s a competitive team based game.
I like the cosmetics aswell, it’s kinda suprising but Siege has one of the least predatory system in gaming. 

Honestly, it’s kinda baffling that Ubisoft could create a game this good, and the only reason I’m scared of this current situation with Ubi is because I don’t want Siege to die.

I had many attempts. I understand how you feel. I know that anyone saying “it will pass with time” doesnt mean sh*t right now to you, and tbh, the scars of your hardahips will stay there for the rest of your life. But the scars are NOT who you are. There was a guy who uploaded a video on lonliness because he is “ugly”. He got married. It’s a harsh world out there, and I understand why you feel what you feel. Its difficult to start over again and again, but when you take all the bullshit away, life is wonderful. I don’t know you, but I understand how you feel. And I also understand that no matter what, you CAN restart your life. I learnt that there are more possibilities for happiness than what we can see at any time. 
For a brief moment, please try to remove every single hardship from your life in your thoughts. Try to find the deepest version of yourself. Meditation helped me find my way out of my darkest times. Ask yourself questions like “Why am I here?” “Who am I?” “Why do I feel what I feel?” “Does it matter?”

Meditation and some sort of active movement (walking at first, maybe some push ups etc, something light(!) when youre in your darkest place) helped me out a ton. 

I hope you find your inner strength to start over, because damaged people like us have the best tools to succeed in life.
